content.title: The Wonderful World of Wetlands: A Roving Interpretive Display
content.summary: The Wonderful World of Wetlands is a no-cost, interactive educational display available for schools and community centers within a 10-mile radius of the Majestic View Nature Center. Designed for K-5 students, the display includes informational posters and biofacts about wetlands and their ecosystems, and can be reserved for up to five days. To request the display, organizations must provide two tables, a point of contact, and anticipate at least 20 participants engaging with the display.
content.body:
![Display table with bins and placards explaining Wetlands, Ecosystem Services, and more](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=6183)The Wonderful World of Wetlands is an interpretive display that you can reserve for your students! Nature Center representatives will deliver and set up this interactive, self-guided educational display at your school, library, or community center within a 10 mile radius of the Nature Center at no-cost. Aligned with [Colorado State Science Standards](/DocumentCenter/View/5969) and designed to aid K-5 teachers and their students achieve an understanding of wetlands, this hands-on display explains what wetlands are, different types of wetland habitats, and provides a closer look at some of the amazing animals that live in wetlands.

[Reserve the Table](https://arvada-mvnc.form.transform.civicplus.com/53816 "Request a Program form opens in a new tab or window")

## **About**

The Wonderful World of Wetlands display functions as a self-guided educational program and can be reserved to be delivered to a school or community center for five days or less. The display is available at no-cost for schools and community centers within a 10 mile radius of Majestic View Nature Center. For locations outside of this radius, please contact us for pricing.

The display consists of four informational posters and a selection of biofacts designed to be set up on two tables that learners can interact with through touch and exploration. Table 1 focuses on defining a wetland and understanding their ecosystem importance. Table 2 focuses on the animals that rely on wetland habitats. [Click here to check out the inventory of each table.](/DocumentCenter/View/6239)

The educational display is best set up in a common area or classroom depending on the intended use and program needs. It can be used for brief, informal interpretive interactions or used alongside an educator’s lesson plan for a more in-depth learning activity. For educators wishing to provide guided (grade-level) experiences in conjunction with the display, extension activities and related worksheets may be downloaded upon request.

## **Requirements**

In order to set up this display in your space, you will need:

- Two 6’ tables provided by your organization (folding and lunchroom tables work well for this)
- Functional space to provide the two 6’ tables next to or near each other that does not impede foot traffic that is available for the full time of your reservation. The space must be indoors in a climate-controlled area - no pavilions or humid areas.
- One person from your organization who will serve as MVNC’s point of contact
- Delivery and pick-up dates (min. 3 days, max. 5 days)
- Must be a public area or community center (e.g. library, rec center, school). If you have a group that does not have a public area, you can request the table be set up at Majestic View to visit it at the Nature Center.
- At least 20 people that you anticipate will engage with the table. Please let us know who and how many you anticipate (if you have a large group, we recommend rotations).
- In order to confirm your rental request, please provide a working credit card to be held on file. While we anticipate that there will be normal wear and tear on display components, schools will be charged to replace missing or damaged items. See inventory sheet for the cost to replace missing or damaged items.

## **How To Request**

Please complete the Roving Table Request Form in order to submit your rental request. Please include your organization’s name, address, intended use or purpose, number of participants, and point of contact, and your organization’s credit card information.

After receiving confirmation from our staff, the display will be delivered to your chosen location and set-up by a Majestic View Nature Center representative. At the end of your rental, the display will be broken-down and transported by a Nature Center representative. It is recommended that your organization’s point of contact be available at the drop off time to verify that all inventoried items are present.

*In the event of severe weather, illness, or other emergency Majestic View Nature Center staff will make our best effort to reschedule the table to accommodate your group as close to the requested dates as possible.*

[Reserve the Table](https://arvada-mvnc.form.transform.civicplus.com/53816 "Request a Program form opens in a new tab or window")
